title: Unifying Finite Differences and Semi-Lagrangian Schemes via Localized Matrix Exponentials
summary: We present a unified framework for the construction of localized exponential integrators that bypasses the traditional trade-off between the accuracy of global spectral methods and the efficiency of sparse finite differences. By evaluating the matrix exponential of a discrete operator strictly within a local stencil of size $n$, we "harvest" integration weights that naturally incorporate high-order temporal corrections.
